summary: debrief page: three machinery shapes the swaps still miss, seen on the live five-hour page at 04:35Z 2026-09-17 (entries 13 and 21): a branch name with no dot or underscore ('codex/tonight'), a seven-character commit id ('tip ca8339e', below the eight-character record-number rule), and a bare call written as 'reviewed()' (the call rule needs a dot). All three predate change c79a35661f9c's round-5 fixes and are outside its findings F1-F11, so they were left alone.
